firstBattleIntro: Enemies ahead. Before we fight, let's decide where I should stand.
firstBattleDeploy: Drag my portrait onto the glowing tile.
firstBattleStart: That position will do. Let's begin the battle.
firstBattleMove: Every action costs AP. The number on each tile is the AP it takes to move there. Let's step forward one tile.
firstBattleSkill: Frost Bolt reaches 2 to 3 tiles away. It can't hit anything too close, so be careful.
firstBattleAim: Choose a target. The number above its head is the damage you will deal.
firstBattleThreat: Select the remaining enemy. You'll see the tiles its attacks can reach.
firstBattleThreatFar: Its attack only reaches the tiles next to it. Moving closer costs it AP too, so it can't reach me yet.
firstBattleAp: Party AP is shared by the whole party, and there's still some left. But I can only use the 4 on this gauge per turn, and 1 isn't enough to attack.
firstBattleEnemyPhase: It's the enemy's turn. Watch how they move.
firstBattleNoAttack: It used up its AP getting close, so it couldn't attack.
firstBattleOutro: Now it's right next to me. Frost Bolt can't reach an enemy that close. ...The rest is up to you.
baseIntro: Let me show you around our base.
baseTower: Buildings only work on warm tiles. Warm tiles are around the Heat Tower and wherever pipes reach.
baseHeat: Heat is limited. Pipes and working buildings each use some of it.
baseOpenMembers: Instead of pipes, members can keep tiles warm too. Tap here.
basePlace: Try placing me on the glowing tile.
baseWarm: It's warm around me now. A mage warms the tile they stand on and the tiles next to it.
baseWork: Buildings in a member's work range work faster. With a Storehouse in range, the member carries goods there, so they can be held longer.
baseSelectRefinery: Next to the Heat Tower is the Refinery. Tap it.
baseRefinery: Here you can combine materials into the next grade. It uses no heat.
baseOutro: You can move members any time by opening the panel. Let's spread the heat little by little.
